rows.note: Use 營養素 as the all-purpose term for a nutrient as a substance the body can use.

example.english: This food has a nutrient that the human body needs.
example.traditional: 呢種食物有一種人體需要嘅營養素。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 sik6 mat6 jau5 jat1 zung2 jan4 tai2 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jing4 joeng5 sou3

rows.note: Use 養分 especially for nutrients in soil, plants, or other biological growth contexts.

example.english: Adding compost gives the soil a nutrient boost, so the flowers grow well.
example.traditional: 啲泥土加咗堆肥，就有足夠養分，啲花先至生得靚。
example.jyutping: di1 nai4 tou2 gaa1 zo2 deoi1 fei4 zau6 jau5 zuk1 gau3 joeng5 fan6 di1 faa1 sin1 zi3 saang1 dak1 leng3

rows.note: Use 營養成分 when discussing the nutrient components listed in food or a food product.

example.english: The nutrient components are clearly listed on the back of the package.
example.traditional: 你睇吓包裝後面，營養成分寫得好清楚。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 baau1 zong1 hau6 min6 jing4 joeng5 sing4 fan6 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2
